title: CH62048: Storage And Handling Of Materials
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Objectives of material storage. Characteristics of particulate solids: angle of
repose, stress development, etc. Considerations in the storage of bulk solids.
Flow behavior of bulk solids in bins and through apertures. Mechanical design
of bins. Design principles of open and closed stock pile.Feeding of materials:
Belt feeder, Apron feeder, Rotary table feeder, Screw feeder, Vibratory feeder,
Reciprocating feeder, etc. â their design and specific applications in chemical
and allied industries.Conveying of materials: Mechanism of bulk material
conveying. Classification and selection of conveying equipment, their
characteristics and applications. Design features of Belt conveyor, Elevating
conveyor, Screw conveyor, etc.Pipe-line transport of materials: Importance and
applications of pneumatic and hydraulic conveying, their advantages,
disadvantages and limitations. Sizing of pipe-line transport systems.
